description: Aspirants S3 is all set to premiere on Prime Video on March 13, 2026. The much-awaited season brings back Naveen Kasturia as DM Abhilash in a story layered with tension, friendships, rivalry, and two compelling timelines. Directed by Deepesh Sumitra Jagdish and produced by The Viral Fever, the series returns with its beloved cast and high emotional stakes.
title: Aspirants Season 3 OTT Release Date Announced: When and Where to Watch it Online?

description: Capcom has announced the next Capcom Spotlight event. The digital presentation will be livestreamed this week on March 5. Capcom Spotlight will be roughly 30 minutes long and will feature games like Pragmata, Mega Man: Dual Override, Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection and more.
title: Capcom Spotlight Livestream Announced for This Week; Will Feature Pragmata, Mega Man: Dual Override and More

description: Apple launched the iPhone 17e as a direct competitor to the Pixel 10a. The new phone runs on Apple's A19 chip and has a 48-megapixel rear camera unit. Here's a quick comparison between the iPhone 17e and Pixel 10a. You can choose the Pixel 10a if you prefer better camera performance and display experience. iPhone 17e is a good choice if you want long-term software support, wireless MagSafe charging and enhanced performance.
title: iPhone 17e vs Google Pixel 10a: Price in India, Specifications Compared

description: The iPhone 17e has been launched as the latest addition to Apple’s non-flagship iPhone lineup. Arriving almost exactly a year after the iPhone 16e, the latest handset from the Cupertino-based giant aims to attract first-time iPhone buyers while offering a much lower price tag than the iPhone 17 models. It brings several key upgrades to the table, including the A19 SoC and double the base storage. The iPhone 17e finally gets MagSafe support, too.
title: iPhone 17e vs iPhone 16e: Price in India, Features and Specifications Compared

description: Apple has launched a new MacBook Air with an M5 chip in India. The latest model comes in two display options and four colour options and is claimed to deliver up to 18 hours of battery life in a single charge. The M5-powered MacBook Air has 512GB of storage as standard, and it can be configured up to 4TB. The laptop ships with macOS Tahoe and offers Apple Intelligence features.
title: MacBook Air With M5 Chip, Up to 15.3-Inch Display Launched in India

description: MacBook Pro (2026) has been launched in India by Apple with the new M5 Max and M5 Pro processors. The new laptop is scheduled to be available for pre-order in the country via the Apple India online store. The MacBook Pro (2026) is offered in Silver and Space Black colourways, 14-inch and 16-inch display sizes, and M5 Pro and M5 Max processor configurations. The laptop is equipped with a 12-megapixel webcam with Apple’s Center Stage and Desk View support. It features Apple’s backlit Magic Keyboard. The MacBook Pro (2026) also features a Touch ID sensor for security.
title: MacBook Pro (2026) Launched in India With M5 Pro, M5 Max Chips, Up to 16-Inch Display: Price, Specifications

description: Mobile World Congress (MWC) 2026, which began on March 2, is in full swing. Hosted by the Global System for Mobile Communications Association (GSMA), the latest edition of the trade show is set to run till March 5. During the event, various companies, like Motorola, Lenovo, Tecno, Qualcomm, Honor, and Vivo, have showcased and unveiled new products and technological innovations. However, more announcements and demonstrations from tech giants like MediaTek and Meta are on the way in the coming days.
title: MWC 2026 Roundup: All the Top Announcements and Noteworthy Products Launched So Far

description: NASA’s Carruthers Observatory has begun its two-year science mission to study Earth’s hydrogen-rich exosphere from a halo orbit at Sun–Earth L1. Equipped with ultraviolet cameras, the small satellite will continuously image the faint geocorona, tracking how solar storms and fast solar wind streams cause the upper atmosphere to expand, contract, and gradually lose hydrogen into space over time.
title: NASA’s Carruthers Observatory Begins Mission to Study Earth’s Hydrogen Halo

description: Tanvi The Great is an emotional 2025 drama now streaming on Prime Video. Directed by Anupam Kher, it tells the inspiring story of Tanvi Raina, an autistic girl who follows her late father’s dream of reaching Siachen.
title: Tanvi The Great Now Streaming on Prime Video: An Inspiring Autistic Hero’s Journey

description: The Epson EpiqVision Mini EF-22N projector comes with an interesting set of features and specifications. The projector offers a display size up to 150 inches and Full HD resolution, with HDR10 and HLG support. It also comes with 1,000 lumens and Epson 3LCD technology. You also get Google TV with Google Cast support. The projector also offers dual 5W speakers with Dolby Audio.
title: Epson EpiqVision Mini EF-22N Review: A Premium Portable Laser Projector

description: Samsung is running a ‘Holi Hai' discount sale in India with offers across its Bespoke AI home appliances products. The sale brings discounts on Samsung's latest Bespoke AI refrigerators, washing machines, air conditioners and microwaves. Under Samsung's Holi Hai campaign, customers can get up to Rs. 20,000 cashback on select appliances. Samsung is also providing a special ‘1 EMI Off’ benefit with zero down payment options on select models. The Samsung Holi Hai sale will end on March 22.
title: Samsung Announces ‘Holi Hai’ Sale With Cashback on Bespoke AI Appliances

description: Written and directed by Bill Condon, Kiss of the Spider Woman is an American musical drama film that is releasing soon on Lionsgate Play.
title: Kiss of the Spider Woman OTT Release Date: Know When and Where to Watch it Online

description: Meta is said to be testing new shopping and research capabilities within its artificial intelligence (AI) assistant. According to a report, the firm has been developing features that would allow users to research products and receive shopping suggestions directly on its AI assistant, dubbed Meta AI. This move is reportedly seen as an extension of Meta’s broader attempts to compete with other AI platforms like OpenAI’s ChatGPT and Google’s Gemini.
title: Meta AI Reportedly Testing Personalised Shopping Recommendations to Compete With ChatGPT, Gemini

description: Vanchana will be released on March 3, 2026, on Sun NXT. It is a courtroom tale that shocks everyone with its storyline. It could not do great at the box office; however, there is a lot of buzz bout it on social media. It has been produced by Gowri Marpu under the banner of Chandi Durga Entertainments.
title: Vanchana OTT Release: When and Where to Watch the Courtroom Drama

description: Xiaomi could be moving to a new rear camera setup on the Xiaomi 18 series. The company could use a 200-megapixel sensor in the standard Xiaomi 18. The Xiaomi 18 Pro and Xiaomi 18 Pro Max, on the other hand, are said to feature a  200-megapixel main camera and a 200-megapixel periscope telephoto lens. This would be a considerable upgrade over the Xiaomi 17 series. The new lineup is expected to be launched in the second half of this year. They could run on the Snapdragon 8 Gen 6 series SoC.
title: Xiaomi 18, Xiaomi 18 Pro, Xiaomi 18 Pro Max Early Leak Reveals Rear Camera Details

description: Oppo Find N6 will be launched in China in March as the latest addition to the Chinese smartphone maker’s foldable lineup, the company has announced. The phone is now available for pre-order in the country via the Oppo China online store. The handset is confirmed to be showcased at the ongoing Mobile World Congress (MWC) 2026 in Barcelona, Spain. Ahead of its global unveiling, the phone has reportedly been spotted at the event, offering a better look at its creaseless foldable screen. While the company has yet to reveal the exact launch date, reports suggest that the Oppo Find N6 will be launched on March 17.
title: Oppo Find N6 Reportedly Appears at MWC 2026; Company Confirms March Launch in China

description: Resident Evil Requiem has now become the highest user rated game of all time on Metacritic. With a user score of 9.5 on the website, the survival horror game is now tied with Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 as the top user rated game on Metacritic. Requiem has also topped Steam's Top Sellers chart, proving to be a sales hit for Capcom.
title: Resident Evil Requiem Becomes Highest User Rated Game of All Time on Metacritic

description: Tecno Camon 50 Ultra 5G was showcased by the Chinese smartphone maker on the first day of Mobile World Congress (MWC) 2026 in Barcelona, Spain. The handset will be launched in select global markets later. However, the key specifications and features of the phone have been revealed by the tech firm. It sports a 6.78-inch 1.5K (1,208 x 2,644 pixels) 3D Curved AMOLED display, offering up to 144Hz of refresh rate, up to 4,500 nits of peak brightness, 2,304Hz PWM Dimming, and Corning Gorilla Glass 7i protection. It is powered by a MediaTek Dimensity 7400 Ultimate chipset.
title: MWC 2026: Tecno Camon 50 Ultra 5G Unveiled With 6,500mAh Battery, 50–Megapixel Camera

description: The Vivo Y21 5G is said to be in development as the latest addition to the brand’s Y-series. While the China-based company has yet to confirm the handset, it has allegedly been spotted on a cellular operator’s website. The listing reveals several key details about the purported smartphone, along with its anticipated pricing. It is said to feature a 120Hz HD+ LCD screen and MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset. The Vivo Y21 5G may pack a 6,500mAh battery.
title: Vivo Y21 5G With Dimensity 6300 Chip Listed on Cellular Operator’s Website Ahead of Launch

description: Tecno Pop X 5G is said to be in the works. Tecno is yet to confirm its arrival, but ahead of it, the phone has appeared on the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) website, hinting at an imminent India launch. It was also spotted on the IMEI database. The appearance of Tecno Pop X 5G on the BIS and IMEI listing indicates that the Pop X 5G could launch shortly after the 4G variant. It is likely to come as an affordable 5G handset.
title: Tecno Pop X 5G Allegedly Listed on BIS, IMEI Websites; Could Launch in India Soon

description: Oppo Find X9 Ultra will be launched globally later this year, the Chinese tech firm announced on Tuesday. The upcoming handset is set to be the third phone in the company's flagship lineup, which currently includes the standard Find X9 model and the Find X9 Pro. Additionally, the company has also confirmed that the Oppo Find X9 Ultra will be equipped with a Hasselblad-tuned rear camera setup. This comes weeks after Oppo's Zhou Yibao confirmed that the handset will pack a battery exceeding 7,000mAh capacity.
title: Oppo Find X9 Ultra Global Launch Confirmed; Set to Arrive Later This Year

description: Apple is said to be exploring the possibility of partnering with Google to help power the next generation of Siri. Amidst the challenges faced in scaling its artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure, the Cupertino-based tech giant has held internal discussions about using Google’s AI models and infrastructure to support more advanced Siri features, particularly as it works to introduce generative AI capabilities, according to a report.
title: Apple Reportedly Considering Google’s Gemini Infrastructure for Advanced Siri Features

description: The iQOO 15R will be available for purchase in India beginning today at 12pm IST, following its launch in February. The mid-flagship from the Vivo sub-brand sits below the iQOO 15R in the company’s smartphone lineup. It sports a 1.5K 144Hz AMOLED screen. The handset is powered by the Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chip, which also powers the OnePlus 15R and several other mid-flagships. The OnePlus 15R runs on OriginOS 6 and packs a 7,600mAh battery.
title: iQOO 15R With Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 Chip Goes on Sale in India Today: Price, Offers

description: iQOO Z11x 5G will launch in India on March 12. iQOO shared new official posters of the upcoming phone on X, revealing its design and colour options. It will be available in at least two colour options with a 7,200mAh battery. The battery is claimed to offer up to 40 hours of video playback time on a single charge. The iQOO Z11x 5G will be priced around Rs. 23,000 in India. It will ship with the MediaTek Dimensity 7400 Turbo chipset.
title: iQOO Z11x 5G India Launch Date Announced; Amazon Availability and Key Features Revealed

description: Nothing Phone 4a will be available for purchase days before it goes on sale in the country, at an exclusive event in Bengaluru on March 7 at 6 pm IST, the London-based smartphone maker announced on Tuesday. The drop event will be held at the recently inaugurated Nothing Store, situated at 660/1, 100 Feet Road, 1st Stage, Indiranagar, Bengaluru. During the event, the first 100 Nothing Phone 4a customers will be able to get an exclusive engraved edition of the handset, along with a complimentary Nothing Ear A TWS. This comes soon after the company showcased the upcoming phone in Black, Blue, Pink, and White colourways at MWC 2026.
title: Nothing Phone 4a to Go on Sale in Bengaluru at Exclusive Drop Event Days After India Launch

description: In a recent post on Weibo, Li Jie Louis, President of OnePlus China, confirmed that the OnePlus 15T will feature the new LUMO periscope telephoto lens. This new sensor is claimed to deliver better long-range photos and improved portrait shots. The handset will offer improvements in battery performance and heat management. Further, the OnePlus 15T will come with narrow bezels on four sides.
title: OnePlus 15T Confirmed to Feature LUMO Periscope Telephoto Lens, Narrow Bezels

description: Oppo K14 5G will be launched in India on March 9 at 12 pm IST, the Chinese smartphone maker announced on Monday. Additionally, a dedicated microsite for the upcoming handset is now live on Flipkart, confirming its availability in the country via the e-commerce platform. The company has also revealed the design, battery capacity, charging speed, and colour options of the soon-to-be-launched Oppo K14 5G. The handset is teased to feature a dual rear camera setup. The phone will be offered in two colourways, Purple and White. It will ship with an unspecified version of ColorOS.
title: Oppo K14 5G India Launch Date Announced Along With Availability, Colourways: See Expected Specs

description: Bethesda is reportedly getting ready to launch its space RPG Starfield on PS5. A noted leaker has shared the purported release date of the game on PS5. Starfield will reportedly launch on Sony's console on April 7. As per the leak, pre-orders for the game will go live later this month.
title: Starfield PS5 Release Date, Pricing and Pre-Order Details Leak; Will Reportedly Launch Next Month

description: Vivo showcased its upcoming flagship, the Vivo X300 Ultra, at Mobile World Congress (MWC) 2026 on Monday. It is expected to be positioned as the brand’s top-tier flagship, with a strong emphasis on imaging capabilities and premium hardware. The handset was seen with a SmallRig video cage and a massive Zeiss telephoto extender kit. Alongside its showcase at the Barcelona event, Vivo also confirmed the global launch of the X300 Ultra.
title: Vivo X300 Ultra Teased With Zeiss 400mm Extender Kit at MWC 2026; Global Launch Confirmed
